output.one_liner: Telegram is a free messaging platform offering APIs for bots, login widgets, and MTProto client development.
output.access_note: Developers can obtain a free API ID and hash by registering on Telegram's developer site.
output.blocker: Requires implementation of Telegram's custom MTProto protocol or use of the Bot HTTP API; no single unified SDK.

evidence.quote: We welcome all developers to use our API and source code to create Telegram-like messaging applications on our platform free of charge.
Telegram offers app and website developers a free and open platform that lets over 1 billion users seamlessly sign up and log in with their Telegram accounts.
Everyone is welcome to use our open source code. ... It is necessary that you obtain your own API id before you publish your app.
Login Widget ... returns an ID token containing user claims.
